The graduate students — all from computer science — join more than 1,900 distinguished honorees advancing research in the fields of bioengineering, computer science, energy science and business. September 12, 2025 In Memoriam: Professor Andrew R. Neureuther, pioneer of integrated circuit simulation, passes at 84 Andrew R. Neureuther, a distinguished professor emeritus of electrical engineering and computer sciences at the University of California, Berkeley, passed away on September 9th, 2025, shortly after his 84th birthday.
